note: Complete set of typed patch ops (PS01_BUILD_PLAN.md section 4.3). Ops are data; every leaf value in a patched request must carry provenance (arg, arg:coerced, arg:enum_mapped, spec_default, credential).

ops.provenance: value moves with the key, origin preserved
ops.description: Rename a key within a parent object (`path` = parent dotted path, '' for root)

ops.provenance: origin preserved for every leaf under `from`
ops.description: Move a subtree to a new dotted path

ops.provenance: allowed only if lossless (round trip); origin `arg:coerced`
ops.description: Lossless type coercion of a leaf

ops.provenance: keys are logical enum values; values appear in an observed allowed list
ops.description: Map a logical enum value to an observed wire value

ops.provenance: read side only, no provenance needed, must pass type check
ops.description: Remap a logical response field to a new wire path
